Protector.description: Tasked by the powers of good to guard the weak, manifesting radiant energy to ward off foes.

features.name: Radiant Soul
features.tldr: When you unleash your celestial revelation, spectral wings sprout from your back, granting you a flying speed.

Scourge.description: Charged with rooting out evil where it hides, brimming with a blinding inner radiance that leaks outward.

features.name: Radiant Consumption
features.tldr: When you unleash your celestial revelation, searing light radiates from your eyes and mouth, scorching nearby enemies.
